verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment saying Vercel offers "only JS/TS/Go, or WebAssembly gimmicks." That implies Go and WebAssembly are available beyond JavaScript, but does not tie them to edge functions specifically. First-party docs on server-side compute (Fluid compute) and request-time code (middleware) never name any supported language. missing for 10: first-party documentation of non-JS edge runtimes, Python edge support, Rust support (native or via WebAssembly), confirmation that Go runs at the edge rather than only in serverless functions, and hands-on corroboration.
